title: Remove all payment-bearing provider routes from active FA3
decision: FA3 SHALL operate with free/local/self-hosted routes only. Subscription, PAYG, purchased-credit, paid-seat, paid hosted API and production enterprise-license routes are removed or denied.
removed_paid_surfaces_from_mixed_provide: Stable Audio hosted API / Large remote API / enterprise-only route
retained_free_surfaces: Stable Audio 3 Medium local subject to ordinary license/runtime admission
Obsidian local desktop and local Markdown vault
Open Sora Plan / Helios / Stability SGM video references subject to existing license gates
supersedes: all conflicting paid-route clauses in earlier provider, service-access, deployment and fallback records
